title: Menu
description: The action menu behind a trigger: a ⋯ (or your own Button) with items that have an icon, a description line, a shortcut or hint, a check, a spinner, a link, a reason when disabled, and group headings. Danger items always go last after a divider; hidden items (and empty groups) leave the list; below sm it opens as a bottom sheet.
when: Secondary actions of a row, card or page (Đổi tên, Nhân bản, Xoá): G2, G4.
The ⋯ overflow of a toolbar, a bulk bar or a detail header (G2, G9, G12).

instead.need: Other ways to start the main action (manual, import)
Actions on a card in a grid

a11y: WAI-ARIA menu button: Enter / Space / ↓ open on the first item, ↑ on the last; arrows, Home, End move; a letter jumps to the next item starting with it; Escape closes and returns focus to the trigger; Tab closes.
A check makes the item menuitemcheckbox with aria-checked; a disabled item with a reason stays reachable (aria-disabled) and its reason is its description; a group is role=group named by its heading.

examples.title: Groups, states and danger last
examples.description: Xoá is first in the code and shows last; the hidden item is not listed; Gửi qua Zalo says why it is off.
